subject: Re: Model mix & token volumes — pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Steir <alex.steir@brightlayerhealth.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@brightlayerhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + model-mix ask (token volumes + target $/1M)

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and two asks so we can put together a provisional pricing and capacity plan for BrightLayer:

Recap (high level):
- Use case: assisted clinical notes + patient summarization for care teams. Low latency for UI chat (sub-500ms target) and nightly batch embeddings for search and similarity.
- Expected user base: pilot ~100 clinicians, ramp to ~2,500 over 12 months.
- Key constraints: PHI requirements (VPC/private), predictable monthly spend, and retraining cadence for domain-specific prompts.

Asks (for pricing model mix):
1) Can you confirm expected monthly API volume broken down by workload type (chat vs embeddings vs rerank/batch)? if you only have total tokens or monthly calls that's fine — we can map it.
2) What's your target cost range per 1M tokens or monthly budget range? e.g., target $/1M tokens or target spend for pilot vs prod.

We're preparing a couple of model-mix scenarios (conservative vs optimized) and will show unit economics at the 1M-token level and for your projected monthly totals. I'll attach a quick sheet with assumptions.

Next step: if you can send the rough volumes by end of week we can deliver a provisional quote + recommended model variants and quantization options by Tuesday next week.

Thanks,

—Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightLayer-token-estimates-0619.xlsx (spreadsheet: projected calls/tokens per workload), RDW-provisional-pricing-0619.pdf (pricing draft)

From: Alex Steir <alex.steir@brightlayerhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Narayanan <priya.n@brightlayerhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + model-mix ask (token volumes + target $/1M)

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the template. I pulled numbers from our analytics team — see the quick breakdown below (monthly averages expected after pilot):

Estimated monthly volumes (post-pilot):
- Chat (UI assisted notes / clinician prompts): ~45M input tokens + ~90M output tokens = ~135M tokens
- Embeddings (nightly indexing / search + similarity): ~12M embedding vectors (we typically count embeddings as calls; for cost mapping assume ~5 tokens equivalence per vector for rough comparison)
- Rerank/batch scoring (backend pipelines that do candidate scoring): ~6M calls, average 400 tokens each = ~2.4B tokens

Rough model mix priority: chat first (low latency), embeddings second (batch), rerank third (high throughput, tolerant to quantization).

Budget guidance: pilot budget target ~$8k/month. Production target (12mo ramp) — ballpark $60k–$90k/month. For unit economics we'd like to aim for ~$150–$300 per 1M tokens effective blended (we know this will vary by model).

Let me know if you want the CSV export — I can share the raw counts. We'll also need to see per-model latency estimates for the chat flows.

—Alex
Alex Steir
Director of Product Integrations | BrightLayer Health
alex.steir@brightlayerhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Steir <alex.steir@brightlayerhealth.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@brightlayerhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + model-mix ask (token volumes + target $/1M)

Alex — perfect, this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifying items and our initial model-mix scenarios below (conservative / optimized) with provisional unit economics at the 1M-token level.

Clarifiers:
- For embeddings: when you say 12M embedding vectors, we'll convert to an equivalent token volume for the blended economics and show per-embedding unit pricing separately.
- For rerank: is the 6M calls number monthly or per-week? (you wrote monthly above but want to confirm).

Initial model-mix scenarios (monthly token split, post-pilot):
- Conservative scenario (higher-quality models):
  - Chat (redwood-chat-3.0): 50% of token volume (priority low-latency, higher cost)
  - Rerank (redwood-rank-1): 40% (high-throughput scoring, but using mid-cost optimized variant)
  - Embeddings (redwood-embed-1): 10% (batch nightly)
- Optimized scenario (lower cost / quantized where possible):
  - Chat (redwood-chat-3-quant): 30%
  - Rerank (redwood-rank-1-quant+int8): 60%
  - Embeddings (redwood-embed-1-quant): 10%

Provisional unit economics (example, per 1M tokens, blended):
- Conservative: ~$240 per 1M tokens (assumes chat @ $400/1M, rerank @ $180/1M, embed-equivalent @ $80/1M blended)
- Optimized: ~$140 per 1M tokens (assumes more quantization and cheaper rerank execution)

Given your production target of 2.4B tokens/month for rerank in your numbers, rerank is the dominant driver of spend — optimizing rerank costs will have the largest impact on monthly spend.

Next steps:
- Alex/Priya: confirm rerank cadence (monthly vs weekly) and whether embeddings should be priced per vector or converted to token-equivalent for your budgeting.
- Rishi/Dev: I'll loop you in for an ops/latency note — we need latency SLOs for chat to map to Dedicated vs Hosted and to propose GPU sizing.

If Alex confirms the rerank cadence and shares the CSV I can produce a 3-scenario cost projection + recommended Dedicated config and fallback model variants by EOD Monday.

Thanks — attaching updated quick-estimate sheet.

—Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Steir <alex.steir@brightlayerhealth.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya.n@brightlayerhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + model-mix ask (token volumes + target $/1M)

Quick ops note —

Marissa / Dev: for the chat SLO (sub-500ms) we'll likely recommend Dedicated with an autoscale buffer and prefix caching. For the provisional pricing I'll run two Dedicated sizing options:
- Size A (lower latency, higher cost): provision X GPU equivalents to hit median 250–350ms and target 99th pct < 600ms
- Size B (cost-optimized): provision fewer GPUs, aim median 350–500ms with more aggressive caching and batching for rerank pipelines.

Also: if BrightLayer confirms rerank is monthly (not weekly), we can propose scheduling larger batch windows and more aggressive quantization to reduce cost.

Marissa: I'll add latency columns to the cost sheet and a Dedicated sizing tab.

—Rishi
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
